title: Real campaign review lists recipients beside the email, generation always progresses, subjects show, and decoded CSS strings cannot reopen <style>
steps: Run the focused real-campaign server and mounted-UI suites from this branch against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL).
expect: A
Cleaning names removed kinds with counts (<meta> element, onclick attribute ×2, CSS !important, CSS property behavior, HTML comment) and never the removed text.
Without replaceExisting, a generate page without a cursor still creates a new draft after earlier pages; groupDrafted reaches groupTotal and drafts/progress agrees.
A blank subject is refused with REAL_SUBJECT_REQUIRED; the recipient list filters by content state and rejects unknown states.
GET /api/ops/invitations/real answers 200 when one campaign's key is missing: that campaign carries a REAL_* unavailable code and no private name, the other keeps its view.
Review content shows the first listed email with its subject without visiting Recipients; approving moves to the next recipient.
Generate missing drafts runs every page in one press, each write carrying the revision the previous one returned, and ends at 'All 318 recipients in this group have a draft'.
fence: Synthetic customers only, private PostgreSQL and a temporary key vault; no credentials, live source or mail transport. Sending stays disabled.

tests: a CSS string whose escapes decode to markup cannot reopen the raw <style> text
removed content is named by kind and counted, never by its text
generating missing drafts reads only recipients without a draft, so every page makes progress
one campaign that cannot be opened is listed with its code and does not hide the others
Review content lists recipients on its own and shows the first email with its subject, no Recipients tab needed
generating missing drafts runs every page in one press and shows group progress
template notes name what cleaning removed instead of showing a bare code
